name: Jiwoo
source:
Jiwoo is intelligent, but also extremely spoiled and stuck-up. He is Heejung's pet and roommate. 
[spoiler]His real name is Miran.[/spoiler]
"You probably don't know cause you're dumb. But it's not every day to see a rabbit like me!"
